decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1)	The proposed development fails to provide adequate spacing to achieve satisfactory amenity space, as well as satisfactory privacy and outlook for the proposed dwelling and adjoining dwellings. It therefore constitutes overdevelopment of the site and is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) .4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - 1)	The proposed dwelling by reason of its siting, size and internal layout would have an adverse affect upon the outlook, light and privacy of No.41 + 39 Clitherow Road and those flats contained within Manor House, Manor Vale.

Condition : 3 - 2)	The proposed dwelling by reason of its siting and design would result in a partial elevation fronting Clitherow Road, which is dull and uninteresting and would fail to address what is a focal point at the end of Clitherow Road.
Condition : 4 - 3)	The proposed dwelling by reason of its size and siting will not provide sufficient amenity space for a residential property of this size.
description: Erection of a two-bedroomed detached dwellinghouse to existing site.
